description: This file defines utility classes and templates for input validation, including ExpectedValues, Validator, and ValidationManager, within the Utils namespace. It includes mechanisms for expected value validation, custom validation functions, and validator management.

classes.name: ExpectedValues
classes.description: Template class for managing expected values of type T, supporting discrete sets, ranges, and regex-based validation.

classes.name: ValidatorBase
classes.description: Base class for validators, providing a virtual destructor.

classes.name: Validator
classes.description: Template class inheriting from ValidatorBase, implementing validation logic based on expected values or custom functions.

classes.name: ValidationManager
classes.description: Class managing multiple validators, allowing addition, validation, and logging of validation results.

methods.name: ExpectedValues::validate
methods.description: Validates a value of type T against the expected criteria (discrete, range, regex).

methods.name: Validator::validate
methods.description: Validates a value of type T using either expected values or a custom function.

methods.name: ValidationManager::addValidator
methods.description: Adds a validator to the manager, either by expected values or a custom function.

methods.name: ValidationManager::validate
methods.description: Validates a value against validators associated with a given key.

methods.name: ValidationManager::setLogger
methods.description: Sets a custom logging function for validation messages.
